pages.title: Our People
pages.heading: The heart behind the chocolate.
pages.intro: Our story begins with the Vigneri family and a Sicilian patisserie. That love of confection is part of the DeCocoa story.
pages.alt: A member of the chocolate team preparing a bag of chocolates

sections.title: Our Roots
paragraphs: Our story begins in the cobblestoned streets of a Sicilian patisserie, where the Vigneri family first fell in love with the art of confection.
In the scent of warm pastries and the flicker of old ovens, a legacy of sweetness began to rise. Tradition, dreams and a devotion to the craft are part of that story.

sections.title: Our Principals
paragraphs: Our vision, mission and focus bring people, craft and care together. They describe the direction behind our chocolate and the experiences we want to create.

items.title: Vision
items.text: A chocolate brand shaped by craftsmanship, creativity and care, with responsible sourcing and a farmers-first future as aspirations.

items.title: Mission
items.text: To craft chocolate with care and create memorable chocolate experiences.

items.title: Focus
items.text: To bring passionate people, innovative craft and sustainable practices together in chocolate with purpose.

sections.title: Our Values
paragraphs: Integrity. Ingredients. Innovation. Invest. Inspire. These are the values named in our story, and the ingredients we bring to our work.
Meet the craft behind the chocolate, then tell us what brings you to DeCocoa.

sections.title: Sweet Careers

sections.title: Promise
paragraphs: Care, creativity and integrity guide our chocolate craft. Our promise begins with attention to the craft and the people behind it.
Quality and food safety are central to the way we want to work, from a first idea to a finished chocolate.

sections.title: Focus
paragraphs: Our focus brings passionate people, innovative craft and sustainable practices together to create chocolate with purpose and care.
Discover how ingredients, processes and shapes connect a chocolate idea with the craft behind it.

sections.title: Sustainability
paragraphs: Responsible sourcing and thoughtful packaging are part of our sustainability aspirations. We consider the people and resources involved in making chocolate as we look toward continuous improvement.
Ask about the sourcing and packaging considerations that matter to your project.

sections.title: Food Safety

Tell us which product you are considering and the ingredient, handling or food safety questions you would like to discuss.

sections.title: How It’s Made
paragraphs: Follow the story of chocolate from cacao to the finished confection. The Experience Center offers a starting point for exploring the ingredients, stages and craft behind chocolate.
Discover the processes on our craft page, then ask about the chocolate-making experience that interests you.
Explore the idea of crafting your own chocolate bar and building a gift box. Let curiosity guide the shapes, finishes and chocolate ideas you would like to discuss.
Ask about Craft Your Own to find out more before planning a visit.

sections.title: Museum & Virtual Exhibition
paragraphs: The Experience Center brings the history of chocolate and how it is made into the story. The museum and virtual exhibition invite a closer look at that journey.
The Green Screen Photo Room is another part of the experience described in our story. Ask about the experience you have in mind.

sections.title: Tours and Classes
